name: shiptheory-csv-import
description: Node.js CLI tool to bulk-import shipments from a CSV file into ShipTheory via their API
summary: Imports multiple shipments at once from a CSV file directly into the shipping system, saving time on manual entry. Warehouse or shipping staff can quickly upload shipment details including product info and delivery preferences, ensuring accuracy and speeding up dispatch. It removes the hassle of inputting each shipment individually by automating the bulk import process.
